display.purpose: Hero headlines and primary section titles.

label.purpose: All system metadata, availability tags, and prices.

shadows.name: Interactive Lift
shadows.purpose: Used to lift sticky elements like the navigation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tactile and confident call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d4b78f; color: #030f09; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; border: none; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.1s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fcfdfc; color: #012a17; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Villa Card
components.description: Primary display for inventory with sharp architectural borders.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; transition: all 0.5s; cursor: pointer; color: white; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(212,183,143,0.5); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-card-tag { font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-card-specs { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.7; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: This system is built to feel confident, severe, and strictly utilitarian. It rejects the flowery marketing fluff typical of real estate in favor of a brutalist, filter-first digital showroom. The experience is engineered to present data and availability with absolute clarity. The aesthetic relies heavily on high contrast, stark typography, and deliberate negative space, rejecting any generic SaaS styling or auto-playing full-screen marketing videos.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: The primary gold accent is used sparingly. Its rarity guarantees it draws the eye to critical CTAs.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: All system metadata (availability tags, prices, structural dimensions) strictly use the Mono font to emphasize their nature as raw data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are stark and flat at rest. Depth is strictly reserved for fixed structural components and active interaction feedback.

dos: Do rely heavily on DM Mono for all data points and metadata.
Do ensure every interactive element depresses (scale: 0.98) on active states.
Do cap body text line length around 65-75 characters.
donts: Don't use generic full-screen auto-playing video heroes with "Discover Luxury" overlay text.
Don't use "About Us" blocks or developer history sections that interrupt the primary discovery flow.
Don't use soft purple gradients or generic AI-style bubbly aesthetics.
Don't use identical, infinitely repeating card grids without structural variation.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default decorative treatment.
